'''Otta Chorrall''' was a [[human]] who worked as a [[Merchant|greengrocer]] on the [[planet]] [[Olega]] during the [[High Republic Era]]. She cultivated a variety of nutritious [[fruit]]s and [[vegetable]]s in a [[Otta Chorrall's cavern garden|cavern garden]] outside [[Olega City]], the [[capital]] of Olega, and then brought them into the [[city]] to sell as a street vendor. In [[132 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{TheAcolyteDate}}</ref> Chorrall walked past the entryway to the [[Olega Jedi temple]] in the [[city]] while a group of [[Jedi]] were [[Skirmish on Olega|interrogating]] the street urchin<ref name="RevengeJustice">{{Acolyte|Revenge / Justice}}</ref> [[Guthan Archi]]. The grocer had light skin and [[Color|ginger]] [[hair]].<ref name="AcolyteVG" /> When passing the [[Jedi temple]], she wore a sloped brown [[hat]] with a brown and black striped [[Clothing|robe]], a brown apron, and black [[boot]]s.<ref name="RevengeJustice" />

==Behind the scenes==
Otta Chorrall appeared in "[[Revenge / Justice]],"<ref name="RevengeJustice" /> the second episode of the live-action [[Disney+]] series ''[[Star Wars: The Acolyte]]'', which aired on [[June 4]], [[2024]].<ref name="Announcement">{{SW|url=news/the-acolyte-teaser-poster|text=''The Acolyte'' Teaser Poster, Premiere Date Revealed}}</ref> The character was not identified in the episode<ref name="RevengeJustice" /> but was named in the [[2025]] reference book ''[[Star Wars: The Acolyte: The Visual Guide]]'', which was written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]].<ref name="AcolyteVG" />
